name: Sinful Mother
source:
Daniel and his mother and father decide to move to a small town on the invitation of his aunt. But soon they are going to regret their decision.

The game is loosely based on Sanbun Kyouden's manga "[url=https://myanimelist.net/manga/15199/Sayuki_no_Sato]Sayuki no Sato[/url]".
translation:
应姨妈的邀请，丹尼尔和他的父母决定搬到一个小镇。但很快他们就会后悔自己的决定。

该游戏大致基于Sanbun Kyouden的漫画“[url=https://myanimelist.net/manga/15199/Sayuki_no_Sato]Sayuki no Sato[/url]”。
